page.text:
Given a function $g : A \to B$ and a subset $X \subseteq A$, the
*restriction* of $g$ to $X$, denoted $g|_X : X \to B$, is obtained by
retaining the operational mapping rule while restricting its domain to
$X$. Conversely, $g$ is said to be an *extension* of $g|_X$ to the larger
domain $A$.
